messages:
Marco R: heads-up — noticed a flurry of PR-eval failures this morning. GH actions artifacts are missing PR metadata so the eval runner treats them as nightly and re-runs, blowing up quota
Anya L: ugh. do we know if it's the upload step or something upstream in the gha env? :eyes:
Sam K: looks like GITHUB_REF is being used in the artifact name but for PRs GITHUB_REF is refs/pull/NN/merge, and our downstream dedupe key expects a simple PR number. mismatch -> no dedupe.
Lin W: can repro locally: artifact contains metrics.json but no pr_number field inside metadata.json. buildkite runner relies on metadata.json to map shard->pr and gate status.
CI Bot: noticed 12 related uploads in last 30m for workflow "eval-nightly". Auto-cleanup skipped for missing dedupe key.
Marco R: short-term fix: add a metadata file during upload with explicit PR and commit. example in gha step: ```run: |
  echo '{"pr": "'$GITHUB_HEAD_REF'", "commit": "'$GITHUB_SHA'", "workflow": "'$GITHUB_WORKFLOW'"}' > eval-metadata.json
  gh actions upload-artifact eval-metadata.json --name=eval-metadata-$GITHUB_SHA
```
Anya L: note GITHUB_HEAD_REF is only set for PR dispatches, for branch runs it's empty. we need fallback to parse GITHUB_REF when head_ref empty.
Sam K: exact snippet we used in my PoC: ```bash
PR=${GITHUB_HEAD_REF:-$(echo $GITHUB_REF | sed -n 's#.*/pull/\([0-9]\+\)/merge#\1#p')}
echo "{\"pr\": \"$PR\", \"commit\": \"$GITHUB_SHA\"}" > eval-metadata.json
```
Lin W: that would work. also propose adding a new dedupe key to runner: "artifact_key = pr||commit||shard" so nightly vs pr can be distinguished explicitly.
Irene P: long term we should stop relying on artifact naming conventions. introduce artifact index with explicit fields: pr, commit, origin (gha/buildkite), shard, job_id. makes reporting and rollbacks safer.
Dev Ops: agree. quick patch pushed to gha in branch ci/fix-eval-metadata. It adds the metadata file and updates upload name. PTAL: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/actions/runs/1234567890
Marco R: deployed the buildkite consumer change to prefer artifact.metadata.pr when present, fallback to legacy parsing. should reduce duplicates. monitor for next hour. :rocket:
CI Bot: alert suppressed for now; will post if duplicate-rate > 5% in 15m window.
Anya L: small follow-up — in PR gating mode we also saw timeouts from continuous batching on shared runners when many small eval shards queue up. might need to add jitter in PR-triggered matrix.
Sam K: proposal: add a 0-30s randomized start_delay for matrix jobs in GH actions when event == pull_request to smooth bursts. simple and effective.
Lin W: also add a label filter so only PRs with path changes to /evals/* trigger full matrix; otherwise trigger lightweight smoke. reduces load hugely.
Irene P: can we emit a metric for "eval-trigger-origin" to track % from PR vs nightly vs manual? want dashboard.
Marco R: yes — I'll wire a counter event to telemetry from the runner when it ingests artifact metadata.pr. add to dashboard under Eval CI -> Ingestion.
Dev Ops: merging ci/fix-eval-metadata now. will roll out to gha-prod after tests. if anyone wants to test on a repro PR ping me and I'll flip samples on.
Anya L: thanks all. big win if we can stop the noisy reruns. will follow up on dashboard and gating labels tomorrow. :thumbsup:
